prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead summary` shows `time 0h 44m` for a flat 3.74 km walk. By Naismith's rule that is 44.9 minutes, and the README says times are rounded to the nearest minute." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git ls-files | head -100; cat README.md; grep -rnE "round|int\(|//|divmod|floor|trunc" --include=*.py . | head -50
cat src/trailhead/report.py src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/pace.py; grep -n "h \|hours" tests/*.py
sed -n 34,45p tests/test_plan.py; cat tests/test_report.py tests/test_cli.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

python - <<'E'
import re,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/pace.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from math import exp\n','from math import exp, floor\n')
s+='''

def format_duration(hours: float) -> str:
    """``<hours>h <minutes>m``, rounded to the nearest minute (halves round up)."""
    whole, minutes = divmod(floor(hours * 60 + 0.5), 60)
    return f"{whole}h {minutes:02d}m"
'''
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/report.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from trailhead.pace import naismith_hours','from trailhead.pace import format_duration, naismith_hours')
s=s.replace('    whole, minutes = divmod(int(summary.hours * 60), 60)\n','')
s=s.replace('f"  time      {whole}h {minutes:02d}m"','f"  time      {format_duration(summary.hours)}"')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/plan.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from trailhead.pace import leg_hours','from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours')
s=s.replace('        whole, minutes = divmod(int(hours * 60), 60)\n','')
s=s.replace('{whole}h {minutes:02d}m','{format_duration(hours)}')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('tests/test_pace.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from trailhead.pace import leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh','from trailhead.pace import format_duration, leg_hours, naismith_hours, tobler_kmh')
s+='''

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("hours", "text"),
    [
        (3.74 / 5, "0h 45m"),  # 44.88 minutes: rounds up, not truncated to 44
        (44.4 / 60, "0h 44m"),
        (1.15, "1h 09m"),  # 1.15 * 60 is 68.99999999999999 in floating point
        (5.999, "6h 00m"),  # rounding carries into the hour
        (12.0, "12h 00m"),
        (0.0, "0h 00m"),
    ],
)
def test_format_duration(hours, text):
    assert format_duration(hours) == text
'''
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('tests/test_plan.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('(1, 0, 14, 6.07), (2, 14, 31, 0.75)','(1, 0, 14, 6.07), (2, 14, 31, 0.74)')
p.write_text(s)
E
git diff tests/test_plan.py | grep '^[+-]'; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; ruff check 2>&1 | tail -3; mypy 2>&1 | tail -2
printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,0\n0,0.033635,0\n' > $TMPDIR/flat.csv; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/flat.csv
